sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_workflow_milestone_values (tenantId,workflowId,milestoneId,optionId,notes,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT w.tenantId,w.id,m.id,o.id,NULLIF(TRIM(:notes),''),:userId,:userId2 FROM tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_event_milestones m ON m.id=:milestoneId AND m.tenantId=w.tenantId AND m.isActive=1 AND m.sourceType='manual' INNER JOIN tbl_event_milestone_options o ON o.id=:optionId AND o.milestoneId=m.id AND o.tenantId=m.tenantId AND o.isActive=1 WHERE w.id=:workflowId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants membership WHERE membership.userId=:authorisedUser AND membership.tenantId=w.tenantId AND membership.isActive=1 AND membership.membershipStatus='active') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE optionId=VALUES(optionId),notes=VALUES(notes),modifiedByUserId=VALUES(modifiedByUserId),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
